author: zeldaOAtrash
quote: Game felt very old and clunky, not fun by today’s modern standards as everything looks extremely ugly. The controls are exhausting to work with, while the game feels like it should be played by babies instead of an adult like myself.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: zeldaOAtrash
quote: The game is incredibly dull and boring while sending you on an extremely familiar Zelda adventure while treating you like a toddler the entire time for wasting money on this garbage. Game is made for babies to play while **** on their pacifiers.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: zeldaOAtrash
quote: The great game of all time, we will never see another videogame with this level of detail and depth created for the player to explore freely and choose how to interact with it. The freedom allows for gameplay never experienced in a grand theft auto before.
